title: Sinners
summary: A stylish genre thriller with a strong sense of place.
why: A good fit for a movie night when you want mystery with atmosphere.

title: The Thomas Crown Affair
why: Clever, stylish, and built around the pleasure of watching two smart people play a game.

title: The Secret Agent
summary: During Brazil's military dictatorship, a man on the run is hunted by assassins while trying to reach his son.
why: A tense, critically acclaimed political thriller with real stakes and a lead performance worth the two-plus hours.

title: You, Me & Tuscany
summary: An aspiring chef impersonates a man's fiancee while staying at his Italian villa, only to fall for his cousin instead.
why: A warm, funny counterweight if you want a night off from mysteries -- pure feel-good escapism.

title: Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu
summary: The theatrical Mandalorian film makes its streaming debut, directed by Jon Favreau and continuing Din Djarin and Grogu's story on the big screen.
why: The year's biggest Star Wars event, now available to watch at home -- a genuine family-night pick.
